items.title: Bitcoin ETFs flip negative for 2026 after $1.28 billion outflow week, worst since June

items.title: Thailand SEC Files Criminal Complaint Against Bitget Ahead of Dec. 5 Access Block
items.summary: Thailand's SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget operator BG Limited for unlicensed Thai trading from 2022 to 2025.

items.title: Elliptic says Binance hackers swapped stolen tokens for $124M in bitcoin, exchange plans more withdrawal reopenings
